items.title: What does the eavesdropper actually see?
items.description: Toggle the key-sharing approach to see why the central problem is not just making the file unreadable, but avoiding sending the secret that opens it.
items.compute: const asymmetric = params.usesAsymmetricKeyPair >= 1; return { readableSecretsExposed: asymmetric ? 0 : 1, privateKeyExposed: asymmetric ? 0 : 1, safeToDeliver: asymmetric ? 1 : 0 };

outputs.label: Key that can open the message exposed
No opening secret crosses the network

items.title: How does the timing gap scale with the number of operations?
items.description: Using the exact per-operation timings measured in L3 on identical 32-byte payloads, where each decrypt operation is one attempt to open an encrypted message, drag the number of operations to see total time for each approach. At 500 operations, this reproduces L3's measured result (14.2ms vs 277.3ms).
